A set of '''Ancient Ruins''' were located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], next to a [[Giant Sarlacc of Ancient Ruins of Tatooine|giant sarlacc]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a battle between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] broke out in the ruins around the sarlacc. During the fight, the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] was attacked by the [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]], but was able to [[Telekinesis/Legends|Force push]] him into the sarlacc. Dooku was able to use [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to get out before being eaten, and escaped.<ref name="Lightsaber Duels" />
